records.literal_gloss: Then Darius the king made a decree, and they searched in [the] house of the scrolls where the treasures [were] deposited, there in Babylon.

en.L: Then Darius the king issued a decree, and they searched in the house of the scrolls, where the treasures were stored, there in Babylon.
en.B: Then King Darius issued an order, and a search was made in the archives where the treasures were stored in Babylon.
en.R: So King Darius gave an order, and his officials searched the royal records kept in the treasure house in Babylon.

es.L: Entonces el rey Darío dio orden, y buscaron en la casa de los rollos, donde se guardaban los tesoros, allí en Babilonia.
es.B: Entonces el rey Darío dio una orden, y se buscó en los archivos donde se guardaban los tesoros en Babilonia.
es.R: Así que el rey Darío dio una orden, y sus funcionarios buscaron en los registros reales que se guardaban en la casa del tesoro en Babilonia.

fr.L: Alors le roi Darius donna un décret, et l’on fit des recherches dans la maison des rouleaux, où l’on déposait les trésors, là, à Babylone.
fr.B: Alors le roi Darius donna un ordre, et l’on fit des recherches dans les archives où l’on gardait les trésors, à Babylone.
fr.R: Le roi Darius a donc donné un ordre, et ses fonctionnaires ont cherché dans les archives royales, gardées dans la maison du trésor à Babylone.

sw.L: Ndipo Dario mfalme akatoa amri, nao wakatafuta katika nyumba ya magombo, ambamo hazina ziliwekwa, huko Babeli.
sw.B: Ndipo Mfalme Dario alitoa amri, na utafutaji ukafanyika katika nyumba ya kumbukumbu ambamo hazina ziliwekwa huko Babeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Mfalme Dario alitoa agizo, na maafisa wake wakazitafuta kumbukumbu za kifalme zilizowekwa katika nyumba ya hazina huko Babeli.

vi.L: Bấy giờ vua Đa-ri-út ban chiếu chỉ, và người ta tìm kiếm trong nhà chứa các cuộn sách, nơi cất giữ các kho báu, tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Đa-ri-út ra lệnh, và người ta tra cứu trong văn khố, nơi cất giữ các kho báu tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Vậy vua Đa-ri-út ra lệnh, và các quan chức của vua tìm trong sách ghi chép của hoàng gia được cất giữ trong kho báu tại Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그때에 다리오 왕이 명령을 내렸고, 그들이 바빌론에서 보물을 보관해 두는 두루마리들의 집을 조사했다.
ko.B: 그래서 다리오 왕이 명령을 내리자, 바빌론에서 보물을 보관해 두는 문서 보관소를 조사하게 되었다.
ko.R: 그래서 다리오 왕이 명령을 내렸고, 그의 관리들은 바빌론의 보물 창고에 보관된 왕실 기록을 찾아보았다.

decisions.choice: the house of the scrolls where the treasures were stored: the royal archive
decisions.reason: Persian kings kept official documents, written on scrolls and tablets, in their treasuries along with valuables. This is the place Tattenai asked the king to search (5:17).

decisions.choice: they searched: the king's officials made the search
decisions.reason: The Aramaic says only "they"; it means the officials who carried out the king's order. Balanced uses a passive and Readable names the officials.

decisions.choice: the archives (B); the royal records (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the house of the scrolls" was.

decisions.choice: "los archivos" (B); "los registros reales" (R); "la casa de los rollos" (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the house of the scrolls" was (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya magombo" (L); "nyumba ya kumbukumbu" (B); "kumbukumbu za kifalme" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the house of the scrolls was, the royal archive; "gombo" is the word for a scroll (Luke 4:17).

decisions.choice: văn khố (Balanced); sách ghi chép của hoàng gia (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the house of the scrolls" was, the royal archive (m1); Literal keeps the words.

decisions.choice: "문서 보관소" (B), "왕실 기록" (R) for "the house of the scrolls"
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable say what the house of the scrolls was; Literal keeps the words.

ko.B: 메대 지방의 엑바타나 성채에서 두루마리 하나가 발견되었는데, 거기에 이렇게 쓰여 있었다. "기록.
ko.R: 메대 지방의 성채 도시 엑바타나에서 두루마리 하나가 발견되었다. 거기에 쓰여 있는 내용은 이러했다. "공식 기록.

decisions.choice: Ecbatana in Media: the Persian kings' summer capital
decisions.reason: The Aramaic name of the city is Achmetha; in Greek it is Ecbatana (modern Hamadan in Iran). It was the old capital of Media, where the Persian kings stayed in the summer. Cyrus was there in his first year, which explains why the record was found there and not in Babylon, where the search began.

decisions.choice: a memorandum: a record of a royal decision for the archive
decisions.reason: The word means a record kept to remind. What follows (verses 3-5) is not the proclamation read to the people (1:2-4) but the official note of the king's decision, with the building's measurements and the payment from the treasury.

decisions.choice: Ecbatana
decisions.reason: The Aramaic form Achmetha is less known than the Greek name Ecbatana, by which the city is known in history; every level uses Ecbatana and the decision gives the Aramaic form.

decisions.choice: "Ecbatana"; "Memoria" (L, B); "Registro oficial" (R)
decisions.reason: The city by its known Greek name at every level, as the English (m1 gives the Aramaic form); the memorandum is a "memoria", a written record kept to remind (m2).

decisions.choice: "Ekbatana" at every level; "Umedi" for Media
decisions.reason: As the English: the Greek name is the one known in history; the meaning decision gives the Aramaic form.

decisions.choice: "Ecbatane"
decisions.reason: The city is known by its Greek name, in French "Ecbatane"; every level uses it, as the English uses "Ecbatana", and the meaning decision gives the Aramaic form.

decisions.choice: Éc-ba-tan; Mê-đi
decisions.reason: The city is known in history by its Greek name, so it is "Éc-ba-tan" at every level, as the English has Ecbatana; Media is "Mê-đi", as Acts 2:9.

decisions.choice: "엑바타나", "메대"
decisions.reason: As the English, every level uses the name by which the city is known in history (Ecbatana); the meaning decision gives the Aramaic form Achmetha (악메다 in older Korean Bibles). 메대 is the usual Korean form for Media.

decisions.choice: "기록" for the memorandum
decisions.reason: The terms note's word; it opens the quotation, which runs to the end of verse 5.

records.literal_gloss: In year one of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: [The] house of God in Jerusalem, the house let it be built, [the] place where they sacrifice sacrifices, and its foundations [be] retained; its height sixty cubits, its width sixty cubits,

en.L: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king issued a decree: As for the house of God in Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid; its height sixty cubits [and] its width sixty cubits,
en.B: In the first year of King Cyrus, the king issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be rebuilt as a place where sacrifices are offered, and let its foundations be laid firmly. Its height shall be {{units:about 90 feet|sixty cubits}} and its width {{units:about 90 feet|sixty cubits}},
en.R: In his first year as king, King Cyrus gave this order about God's temple in Jerusalem: The temple must be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices. Its foundations must be laid firmly. It is to be {{units:about 90 feet|sixty cubits}} high and {{units:about 90 feet|sixty cubits}} wide,

es.L: En el primer año del rey Ciro, el rey Ciro dio orden: En cuanto a la casa de Dios en Jerusalén, que sea edificada la casa, el lugar donde se ofrecen sacrificios, y que sus cimientos sean firmemente puestos; su altura, sesenta codos, [y] su anchura, sesenta codos,
es.B: En el primer año del rey Ciro, el rey dio un decreto acerca de la casa de Dios en Jerusalén: Que la casa sea reedificada como lugar donde se ofrecen sacrificios, y que sus cimientos se pongan con firmeza. Su altura será de {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}} y su anchura de {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}},
es.R: En su primer año como rey, el rey Ciro dio esta orden acerca del templo de Dios en Jerusalén: El templo debe ser reconstruido como lugar para ofrecer sacrificios. Sus cimientos deben ponerse con firmeza. Tendrá {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}} de alto y {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}} de ancho,

fr.L: La première année du roi Cyrus, le roi Cyrus a donné un décret : Quant à la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem, que la maison soit bâtie, le lieu où l’on offre des sacrifices, et que ses fondations soient solidement posées ; sa hauteur, soixante coudées, [et] sa largeur, soixante coudées,
fr.B: La première année du roi Cyrus, le roi a donné un décret au sujet de la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem : Que la maison soit rebâtie comme un lieu où l’on offre des sacrifices, et que ses fondations soient solidement posées. Sa hauteur sera de {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} et sa largeur de {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}},
fr.R: La première année de son règne, le roi Cyrus a donné cet ordre au sujet du temple de Dieu à Jérusalem : Le temple doit être reconstruit comme un lieu où l’on offre des sacrifices. Ses fondations doivent être solidement posées. Il aura {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} de haut et {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} de large,

Kimo chake kiwe {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}},
sw.R: Katika mwaka wake wa kwanza wa utawala, Mfalme Koreshi alitoa agizo hili kuhusu hekalu la Mungu huko Yerusalemu: Hekalu hilo lazima lijengwe upya kuwa mahali pa kutolea dhabihu. Misingi yake lazima iwekwe imara. Kimo chake kiwe {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}},

vi.B: Năm thứ nhất đời vua Si-ru, vua đã ban chiếu chỉ về nhà của Đức Chúa Trời tại Giê-ru-sa-lem: Hãy xây lại nhà ấy làm nơi dâng tế lễ, và hãy đặt nền cho vững chắc. Nhà sẽ cao {{units:khoảng 27 m|sáu mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 27 m|sáu mươi cu-đê}},
vi.R: Vào năm thứ nhất làm vua, vua Si-ru đã ra lệnh về đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời tại Giê-ru-sa-lem như sau: Phải xây lại đền thờ làm nơi dâng tế lễ. Nền đền thờ phải được đặt cho vững chắc. Đền thờ sẽ cao {{units:khoảng 27 m|sáu mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 27 m|sáu mươi cu-đê}},

ko.L: 고레스 왕 제1년에 고레스 왕이 명령을 내렸다. 예루살렘에 있는 하나님의 집, 곧 제사를 드리는 곳인 그 집을 짓고, 그 기초를 튼튼히 놓아라. 그 높이는 60규빗, 그 너비는 60규빗으로 하고,
ko.B: 고레스 왕 즉위 첫해에, 왕이 예루살렘에 있는 하나님의 집에 관하여 명령을 내렸다. 그 집을 제사를 드리는 곳으로 다시 짓고, 그 기초를 튼튼히 놓아라. 높이는 {{units:약 27미터|60규빗}}, 너비는 {{units:약 27미터로|60규빗으로}} 하고,
ko.R: 고레스 왕은 왕이 된 첫해에 예루살렘에 있는 하나님의 성전에 대해 이렇게 명령했다. 제사를 드리는 곳으로 성전을 다시 지어라. 그 기초를 튼튼히 놓아라. 높이는 {{units:약 27미터|60규빗}}, 너비는 {{units:약 27미터로|60규빗으로}} 하고,

decisions.choice: let its foundations be firmly laid
alternatives: let the old foundations be kept
decisions.reason: The participle is rare and its sense is uncertain. It most likely means that the foundations are to be laid so as to bear the building; it may instead mean that the old foundations are to be kept and built on. The words are also sometimes read as part of the description of the place of sacrifice. Every reading has the house rebuilt where it stood.

decisions.choice: sixty cubits high and sixty wide: larger than Solomon's temple, with no length given
decisions.reason: Solomon's temple was thirty cubits high and twenty wide (1 Kings 6:2). The length is missing, and the figures may set the greatest size the king would pay for rather than a plan. The returned exiles in fact built a house that older people thought poor beside the first (3:12; Haggai 2:3).

decisions.choice: the place where they offer sacrifices: the house is a place of worship
decisions.reason: The decree names the purpose of the house: sacrifices to the God of heaven, which Darius will order paid for (verses 9-10).

decisions.choice: {{units:about 90 feet|sixty cubits}}
decisions.reason: A cubit is about 18 inches, so sixty cubits is about 90 feet. Literal keeps the cubit.

decisions.choice: units span: "unos 27 metros" / "sesenta codos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cubit at the published Spanish value (0.45 m, as 1 Chronicles 11:23), so sixty cubits is about 27 metres; Literal keeps the cubit, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "{{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}}"
decisions.reason: As the Swahili style guide: the units setting gives the metric figure (a cubit is about 45 cm) with the original cubits as the alternative; Literal keeps "dhiraa sitini".

decisions.choice: "environ 27 mètres" with "soixante coudées" as the alternative
decisions.reason: French gives metric measures by default (a cubit about 45 cm, as 1 Kings 6:2), where the English gives feet. Literal keeps the cubit.

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 27 m|sáu mươi cu-đê}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the metric measure by default (a cubit about 45 cm), with the cubit as the alternative, as Kings does; Literal keeps "cu-đê". The English converts to feet.

decisions.choice: A units span with metric by default: "약 27미터" with "60규빗" as the alternative; Literal keeps "60규빗"
decisions.reason: The Korean style guide sets metric as the default for Korean units spans (a cubit about 45 centimeters), with the original unit as the alternative.

decisions.choice: The king's decree in 해라체 ("지어라")
decisions.reason: The terms note: the Persian king's decrees and replies are in 해라체.

source.text: נִדְבָּכִ֞ין דִּי־אֶ֤בֶן גְּלָל֙ תְּלָתָ֔א וְנִדְבָּ֖ךְ דִּי־אָ֣ע חֲדַ֑ת וְנִ֨פְקְתָ֔א מִן־בֵּ֥ית מַלְכָּ֖א תִּתְיְהִֽב׃

sw.L: pamoja na safu tatu za mawe makubwa na safu moja ya miti mipya; na gharama itolewe katika nyumba ya mfalme.

ko.R: 커다란 돌을 세 줄 쌓고 새 나무 들보를 한 줄 놓아라. 그 비용은 왕의 금고에서 내주어라.

decisions.choice: three courses of stone and one of timber: the building method of the temple
decisions.reason: The same way of building is described for Solomon's inner court (1 Kings 6:36; 7:12) and in the officials' report (5:8). It may describe the whole wall, repeated in layers, or a single section; the text does not say.

decisions.choice: stone of rolling: large stones (see 5:8)
decisions.reason: As in 5:8, stones so large they were rolled into place.

decisions.choice: the cost from the king's house: the royal treasury pays
decisions.reason: Persian kings supported the temples of their subject peoples. Cyrus's decree in 1:4 called on others to give; this record shows that the crown itself undertook the cost, which Darius confirms from the province's taxes (verse 8).

decisions.choice: the royal treasury (B); the king's treasury (R)
decisions.reason: "The king's house" here means his treasury, the money of the crown.

records.literal_gloss: And also the vessels of [the] house of God of gold and silver, which Nebuchadnezzar brought out from the temple which [was] in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon, let them return and go to the temple which [is] in Jerusalem, to its place; and you shall deposit [them] in [the] house of God.

en.L: And also let the vessels of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be returned and go to the temple that is in Jerusalem, each to its place; and you shall put them in the house of God."
en.B: Also, the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be given back and taken to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its proper place. You shall put them in the house of God."
en.R: Also, the gold and silver objects from God's temple, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, must be given back. They are to be taken back to the temple in Jerusalem, and each one is to be put in its proper place in God's temple."

es.L: Y también los utensilios de oro y de plata de la casa de Dios, que Nabucodonosor sacó del templo que [estaba] en Jerusalén y llevó a Babilonia, que sean devueltos y vayan al templo que [está] en Jerusalén, cada uno a su lugar; y los pondrás en la casa de Dios».
es.B: Además, los utensilios de oro y de plata de la casa de Dios, que Nabucodonosor sacó del templo de Jerusalén y llevó a Babilonia, deben ser devueltos y llevados al templo de Jerusalén, cada uno a su lugar. Los pondrás en la casa de Dios».
es.R: Además, las vasijas y los demás objetos de oro y de plata del templo de Dios, que Nabucodonosor sacó del templo de Jerusalén y llevó a Babilonia, deben ser devueltos. Deben llevarse otra vez al templo de Jerusalén, y cada uno debe ser puesto en su lugar en el templo de Dios».

fr.L: Et aussi, que les ustensiles d’or et d’argent de la maison de Dieu, que Nabuchodonosor a enlevés du temple qui était à Jérusalem et emportés à Babylone, soient rendus et retournent au temple qui est à Jérusalem, chacun à sa place ; et tu les déposeras dans la maison de Dieu. »
fr.B: De plus, les ustensiles d’or et d’argent de la maison de Dieu, que Nabuchodonosor a enlevés du temple de Jérusalem et emportés à Babylone, seront rendus et rapportés au temple de Jérusalem, chacun à sa place. Tu les déposeras dans la maison de Dieu. »
fr.R: De plus, les objets en or et en argent du temple de Dieu, que Nabuchodonosor a pris dans le temple de Jérusalem et emportés à Babylone, doivent être rendus. Ils seront rapportés au temple de Jérusalem, et chacun sera remis à sa place dans le temple de Dieu. »

vi.B: Ngoài ra, các khí dụng bằng vàng và bạc của nhà Đức Chúa Trời, mà Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa đã lấy từ đền thờ tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và đem về Ba-by-lôn, phải được trả lại và đem về đền thờ tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, mỗi thứ về đúng chỗ của nó. Ngươi hãy đặt chúng trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Ngoài ra, những đồ vật bằng vàng và bạc từ đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời, mà Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa đã lấy từ đền thờ tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và đem về Ba-by-lôn, phải được trả lại. Phải đem chúng về đền thờ tại Giê-ru-sa-lem và đặt mỗi thứ vào đúng chỗ của nó trong đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời."

decisions.choice: the vessels Nebuchadnezzar took: their return already told in 1:7-11 and 5:14-15
decisions.reason: The memorandum confirms what the elders said in their answer (5:14-15) and what chapter 1 records: the vessels were handed over to Sheshbazzar to be taken back.

decisions.choice: you shall deposit them: the memorandum turns to address the one responsible
decisions.reason: The verb is singular "you". The record speaks to the official in charge of the return, Sheshbazzar (5:14-15), as an order would.

decisions.choice: each one is to be put in its proper place in God's temple
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two phrases about the vessels' place and leaves out the change to "you", which Literal and Balanced keep.

en.B: "Now therefore, Tattenai, governor of Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai and your colleagues, the officials of the province Beyond the River: keep away from there.

ko.R: 그러자 다리오 왕은 이렇게 답장을 보냈다. "유프라테스 강 서쪽 지방의 총독 닷드내와 스달보스내와 그곳의 동료 관리들은 들어라. 그곳에 가까이 가지 말아라.

decisions.choice: now: the king's reply begins without an opening
decisions.reason: The writer moves from the record found in the archive straight into Darius's letter, leaving out its address and greeting. "Now" in letters marks the turn to business (as 4:13, 14; 5:17).

decisions.choice: the officials: as in 5:6
decisions.reason: The same Persian title as in 5:6; its exact sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: be far from there: do not interfere
decisions.reason: The king does not order the officials out of Jerusalem; he tells them to keep their hands off the work, as verse 7 explains.

decisions.choice: Then King Darius sent this reply
decisions.reason: Readable says who is now speaking, since the Aramaic moves without notice from the old record to Darius's letter (m1).

decisions.choice: plural_you for the officials (verses 6-12)
decisions.reason: Darius writes to Tattenai and his colleagues together, so the orders are the plural setting, as the terms note says for the Aramaic letters.

decisions.choice: "kaeni" (plural) for the king's orders through verse 12
decisions.reason: Darius writes to Tattenai and his colleagues together, so Swahili uses the plural imperative, which English does not show.

decisions.choice: "vous" to the officials
decisions.reason: Darius writes to several officials, so his letter says "vous", while the subjects' letters say "tu" to the king.

decisions.choice: hãy tránh xa nơi ấy (Literal, Balanced); Đừng đến gần nơi ấy (Readable)
decisions.reason: The king tells his officials to keep their hands off the work (m3); verse 7 says what he means. Darius writes to them as "các ngươi" and calls himself "ta", as the terms note sets for the kings' letters.

decisions.choice: "손을 떼라" (B); "가까이 가지 말아라" (R)
decisions.reason: As the meaning decision, the king tells them not to interfere; Balanced uses the Korean idiom for leaving a matter alone, and Literal keeps the words. Readable names the speaker, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: Leave the work of this house of God; [the] governor of the Jews and [the] elders of the Jews, this house of God let them build on its place.

en.L: Leave the work on this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God on its place.
en.B: Let the work on this house of God go on. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its site.
en.R: Do not interfere with the work on this temple of God. Let the governor of the Jews and their leaders rebuild it where it stood before.

es.L: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} la obra de esta casa de Dios; que el gobernador de los judíos y los ancianos de los judíos edifiquen esta casa de Dios en su lugar.
es.B: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que siga la obra de esta casa de Dios. Que el gobernador de los judíos y los ancianos de los judíos reedifiquen esta casa de Dios en su sitio.
es.R: No {{plural_you:se metan|os metáis}} con la obra de este templo de Dios. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que el gobernador de los judíos y sus jefes lo reconstruyan donde estaba antes.

fr.L: Laissez l’ouvrage de cette maison de Dieu ; que le gouverneur des Juifs et les anciens des Juifs bâtissent cette maison de Dieu à sa place.
fr.B: Laissez se poursuivre les travaux de cette maison de Dieu. Que le gouverneur des Juifs et les anciens des Juifs rebâtissent cette maison de Dieu sur son emplacement.
fr.R: N’empêchez pas les travaux de ce temple de Dieu. Laissez le gouverneur des Juifs et leurs chefs le reconstruire là où il se trouvait avant.

sw.L: Iacheni kazi ya nyumba hii ya Mungu; liwali wa Wayahudi na wazee wa Wayahudi waijenge nyumba hii ya Mungu mahali pake.
